description.value: Beban Park Pool is an indoor public swimming pool operated by the City of Nanaimo within the Beban Park recreational complex. It offers drop-in swim sessions alongside programmed aquatic activities for residents and visitors. For touring cyclists, it represents a chance to relax and recover in a heated indoor pool mid-route through Nanaimo.
